subject: [PATCH 1/2] sched_ext: Specialize the TID hashtable compare

2026-09-21.patch_summary: This patch optimizes the comparison function for the TID hashtable in the Linux kernel's scheduling extension. It provides a specialized comparison function that directly compares the TID field of the sched_ext_entity structure, rather than using the generic rhashtable_compare() function. This optimization is intended to improve performance on hot scheduling paths where scx_bpf_tid_to_task() is called.
